description: This file contains platform-specific upgrade functions for the prplOS project targeting the ath79 architecture within the OpenWrt embedded Linux distribution. It defines functions for checking image validity and performing firmware upgrades based on different hardware boards.

methods.name: platform_check_image
methods.description: Checks if the firmware image is valid. Currently always returns success.

methods.name: platform_do_upgrade
methods.description: Performs the upgrade process depending on the board type, delegating to specific upgrade functions.
